The '''Cloud Chaser''' was a short-range atmospheric vehicle that was used on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. This lighter-than-air ship was used by the [[Je'daii Order]].
